node.title: Re: Regex to get file name from the path with spaces
node.author: Corion
node.doctext:
Maybe you want to instead capture everything up to the second double quote?

.*TEXT:\s+"([^"]+)"

If you have both, lines with and lines without double quotes, you will have to show more data.

Update: After reading [haukex] answer, I now realize that I only understood half of your question. Use my answer to extract the full path and then use [mod://File::Spec] to get the actual filename.
